summary: Setup verification of web panel one-click demo logins on forked preview. All 4 demo logins (Admin, Partner, Customer, Merchant) succeed via same-origin /api. Backend sanity curls pass. Merchant Scan QR renders correctly.

backend_sanity.POST /api/auth/verify-otp (+919000000002: 200, returns JWT token for merchant Sharma Electricals

tests_executed.merchant_scan_qr: PASS -> /merchant?tab=scanqr renders Verified Merchant QR for 'Sharma Electricals', Ref: U32QUR6, active/verified/booking-enabled, poster templates & share options visible.

cors_or_login_errors: None. No 'Demo login failed' toast on any role. No CORS errors in console. Same-origin /api routing works (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty as intended).

console_warnings: Two 403 responses observed on protected resources (likely stale token or a role-mismatched request when switching accounts within one page context). Non-blocking for demo login flow.
Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' emitted repeatedly on admin dashboard. Cosmetic — occurs before container mounts; charts render fine subsequently.

critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/src/pages/auth/Login.jsx correctly guards demo buttons behind /auth/demo-status and uses data-testid=demo-{role}. Good.
Consider suppressing the recharts width/height warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer explicit min dimensions to keep console clean.
seed_data_creation: None (backend auto-seeds demo data on startup)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web panel served at preview URL root on :3000 via supervisor 'webpanel'. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must stay empty in web_panel/.env so api.js falls back to window.location.origin for same-origin /api. Demo login buttons are data-testid='demo-admin|partner|customer|merchant' on /login. When automating logins across roles in one page context, use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (not 'networkidle') because dashboards have persistent polling that never idles; also clear localStorage before revisiting /login to force a logout.
